model: X-CUBE Control BACnet data point list
applies_to: TROX X-CUBE central air handling units with the factory X-CUBE Control system.
summary: TROX X-CUBE air handlers are controlled by a factory PLC (X-CUBE Control) that connects to a BMS over BACnet IP. TROX publishes the maximum data point list as an EDE-style table: 17 BMS write objects (heartbeat, reset, system mode, standby, external outdoor temperature and fan/temperature/humidity setpoints), about 100 analog inputs for temperatures, humidities, pressures, airflows, valve/damper/fan positions and filter data, and over 600 binary inputs for alarms, fire dampers, fans and heat recovery. Which objects are live depends on the unit's actual configuration.
notes: This is the maximum list; objects for components a unit doesn't have (extra fans, dampers, fire dampers, KVS run-around coil) stay unused.
BMS write objects are the AO/BO block (BO-1..4, AO-5..17); everything else is read-only.
Units come from the EDE unit-code column (BACnet engineering unit enums: 62=°C, 98=%, 53=Pa, 135=m³/h, 29=%RH, 28=g/kg, 96=ppm, 48=W, 71=h).
Binary inputs reference state-text table 1, which is not printed in this document.
Fan setpoints AO-8/9 carry no engineering unit in the list.
The device instance 200 and device name TROX_856581 come from the example EDE and will differ per unit.

integration.summary: Write AO-5 eInSystemMode = 2 (auto) and keep BO-7 bInSPStandby false so the unit runs, toggle BO-1 bInHeartBeat2PLC so the PLC sees the BMS, and set the supply/extract fan and temperature/humidity setpoints in AO-8..17. Read back AI-89 eOutPVOperationMode, AI-1 eOutEventNotification and the main temperatures, and use BO-2 to reset errors. The list marks the objects that must be set in green; those are the AO/BO block.

minimum_points.name: eInSystemMode
minimum_points.why: Operation mode command: 0 off, 1 manual, 2 auto

minimum_points.name: bInSPStandby
minimum_points.why: Standby when true; must be false for auto run

integration.enable: AO-5 eInSystemMode sets the operation mode (0=unit off, 1=manual, 2=auto); the unit runs in auto only when eInSystemMode is 2, BO-7 bInSPStandby is false and there is no critical error.
integration.heartbeat: BO-1 bInHeartBeat2PLC is the heartbeat from the BMS to the unit PLC and BI-0 bOutHeartbeat2BMS is the PLC's heartbeat back to the BMS. The list does not state a timeout or what the unit does if the BMS heartbeat stops.
integration.remote_sensors: A BMS outdoor temperature can be written to AO-6 fInMeasTempOutdoor. No source-select or timeout object is listed for it.
setup: BACnet IP; the EDE example uses device instance 200 (device object name TROX_856581), which is unit specific.
gotchas: Fan and temperature setpoints have default 0 and full float range in the list; write sensible values before enabling auto.
BO-4 bInTestFireDampers starts a test of all fire dampers.
Many alarm BIs are described as 'normally closed' contacts; check polarity during commissioning.
Humidity setpoints (AO-12/13, 16/17) are in g/kg (absolute), while humidity readings are %RH.
